cohort: Women who gave birth at Al-Wakra Hospital in Qatar in 2019 (n=4816)
finding: Caesarean section rates varied significantly among women of different nationalities, with variations influenced by maternal factors, medical indications, and the CS rate in the country of nationality.
mod_finding: This study investigated cesarean section (CS) rates among women of different nationalities and found variations influenced by maternal factors, medical indications, and CS rates in the country of nationality, suggesting cultural preferences and patient expectations play a role in CS decisions.
